title: [bug] windowEffects not applied on new WebviewWindow()

labels.name: status: needs triage
labels.description: This issue needs to triage, applied to new issues

body:
### Describe the bug

When creating a new _WebviewWindow_ instance, configured "windowEffects" options don't get applied to the Window. 
window.setEffects must be used to apply windowEffects to the newly created _WebviewWindow_.
(Every other options apply normally.)

**This doesn't work:**
![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/fe341ced-f381-4bd0-9066-595706567209)

**This works:**
![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/24af50c9-e86f-484b-ab3a-97dad7bd9a75)

Potential cause:
- maybe WebviewWindowBuilder doesn't pass effects options into WindowBuilder correctly? (I'm not familiar with Rust)
